ModMetaData.name: Material Numbers
ModMetaData.author: Material Numbers contributors
ModMetaData.description:
【简体中文】 材料数值是一款面向 RimWorld 1.6 的材料对比 Mod，设计思路参考并结合了 Stuff List 和 Numbers：像 Stuff List 一样集中列出游戏及其他 Mod 已加载的材料，又像 Numbers 一样支持自由选择属性列、排序数据、调整布局和保存预设。本 Mod 为独立实现，不需要安装 Stuff List 或 Numbers。
使用方法：打开游戏底部的“材料”主标签，先选择一套接近用途的内置预设，再限定材料大类和库存范围；使用“选择列”增删属性，点击表头排序，拖动表头调整顺序或宽度，最后保存为全局自定义预设。“=、×、+”分别表示基础值、材料倍率和材料加成。
主要功能： • 自动发现游戏及其他 Mod 提供的材料定义与可读取属性。 • 自由选择、拖动和缩放列，并保存为全局自定义预设。 • 使用“=、×、+”区分基础值、材料倍率和材料加成。 • 提供概览、建造、护甲与衣物、采集与生产、武器制作、舒适与睡眠、交易与库存七套内置预设。 • 可按材料大类、当前地图或当前储存区筛选，并支持名称搜索与列排序。 • 可识别 Survival Tools Lite 工具属性，不强制依赖 Harmony、HSK 或其他 Mod。
【English】 Material Numbers is a RimWorld 1.6 material comparison mod inspired by the complementary ideas behind Stuff List and Numbers. It gathers loaded materials into one place like Stuff List, while offering Numbers-style column selection, sorting, layout customization, and saved presets. It is an independent implementation and does not require either mod.
How to use: open the Materials main tab, choose a built-in preset, narrow the material group and inventory scope, then use Columns to select properties. Click headers to sort, drag them to reorder or resize, and save the result as a global custom preset. The markers “=”, “×”, and “+” identify base values, material factors, and material offsets.
Features: • Automatically discovers material definitions and readable stats supplied by the game and other mods. • Choose, reorder, and resize columns, then save layouts as global custom presets. • Distinguishes base values, material factors, and material offsets with “=”, “×”, and “+”. • Includes seven built-in presets: Overview, Construction, Armor and Apparel, Gathering and Production, Weapon Crafting, Comfort and Rest, and Trade and Stock. • Filters by broad material group, current map, or current storage, with material search and column sorting. • Recognizes Survival Tools Lite tool stats without requiring Harmony, HSK, or any other mod.
